verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents Product Tax Codes (PTCs) that let developers explicitly categorize catalog items (SaaS, digital goods, services, physical goods, shipping) so tax is calculated per product type per jurisdiction, with preset codes as fallback and taxability_reason explaining outcomes; community confirms this works well for basic address/VAT-based automatic calculation. missing for 10: no independent audit of PTC coverage breadth/accuracy across all category edge cases, and some community reports note gaps for complex international selling scenarios.
